# Parrit.ai

> We turn operational problems into systems that work.

## The single page
- https://parrit.ai/ (English)
- https://parrit.ai/fr (French)
- Agents in production, what AI changes, the path, departments, how data travels through our systems, the team, references, and founder and contact.
- Parrit.ai trains your teams, builds with them and puts software made for your company into production.
- Paul Larmaraud, founder of Parrit.ai. Based in the Lille area, he also works in Paris.
- Service area: Lille, Métropole européenne de Lille, Hauts-de-France, France.

## Journal themes
- https://parrit.ai/journal/themes/harness-engineering (FR: https://parrit.ai/fr/journal/themes/harness-engineering): Design or correct the system around your agents: context, tools, permissions, checks and supervision.
- https://parrit.ai/journal/themes/ai-sprints (FR: https://parrit.ai/fr/journal/themes/ai-sprints): A short cycle with an agreed scope, criteria written before building and a documented decision.
- https://parrit.ai/journal/themes/integration-developpement (FR: https://parrit.ai/fr/journal/themes/integration-developpement): Integrate what exists, build what is missing and orchestrate a supervised system suited to your operations.
- https://parrit.ai/journal/themes/conseil-transformation (FR: https://parrit.ai/fr/journal/themes/conseil-transformation): Start from your operations to decide priorities, build a roadmap and prepare adoption.

## Journal
- https://parrit.ai/journal (FR: https://parrit.ai/fr/journal): what held and what broke on AI systems inside companies, dated and on the record.
- Articles have a single English URL under https://parrit.ai/journal/.
